description: Place an image file (JPEG, PNG, PSD, etc.) as a new Smart Object layer in the active document, optionally offset from center. Rasterize separately if you need to apply pixel-only operations. Open-world: reads from the filesystem. Returns the new layer name, bounds, and updated document context.

file_path.description: Full path to the image file (JPEG, PNG, PSD, etc.)

height_percent.description: Scale the placed layer vertically to this percent of its native height. Omit (or pass 100) to keep native size. Pair with width_percent for uniform scale (set both to the same value).

width_percent.description: Scale the placed layer horizontally to this percent of its native width. Omit (or pass 100) to keep native size. Common ratios: 50 for half-size, 200 for double. Independent from height_percent — pass both to scale non-uniformly.

x.description: X position offset in pixels from the canvas centre (default 0). Negative places the layer further left; bounded at ±300,000 px.

y.description: Y position offset in pixels from the canvas centre (default 0). Negative places the layer further up; bounded at ±300,000 px.

name: ps_place_image
